title: 贵织山堂 Guizhi Shantang
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 映水兰香
evidence.excerpt_zh: 澹泊寧静度河橋而西為映水蘭香西向五楹東南為釣魚磯北為印月池池北為知耕織又北稍東為濯鱗沼映水蘭香西南為貴織山堂祀蠶神（圓明園册）臣等謹按映水蘭香四十景之一額為皇上御書釣魚磯印月池知耕織濯鱗沼貴織山堂諸額皆世宗御書
evidence.summary: West across the stream: 映水蘭香, five bays facing west, with the 釣魚磯, 印月池, 知耕織, 濯鱗沼 and 貴織山堂, a shrine to the silkworm spirit.

evidence.title: 映水兰香 贵织山堂, 天神坛 (S47 section 2.5)
evidence.summary: 贵织山堂 is a small free-standing three-bay hip-and-gable hall for the silk-worm deity, with green columns on the album leaf; silkworm rearing began in the garden in 1729. A 天神坛, three bays, stood south of the scene in the wall ring, by Yangshi Lei plans and a list of 1794.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01) with no label, 3x1 cells: a building stood here, its name unknown.
